svg.text: Ø60 h7 shaft / box throat Ø64
shaft must not touch: check with feelers
Ø80 H8 box / Ø80 f8 follower
Ø100 H9 end plate / Ø100 f8 box spigot
Ø45 j6 journal / gearmotor Ø45 H7
Key 14 x 9 / shaft N9, hub JS9
run in: weep allowed 1st hour, then re-tighten
1. Ribbon-to-trough clearance is set by the agitator OD grind and checked by turning the shaft by hand: 4..6 [.16..24] everywhere.
2. Shaft axis concentric with both stuffing-box throats within 0.5 [.02]: shift the bearings in their Ø17.5 holes before tightening H1.
3. Product zone ends at the box face; the 92 [3.6] gap to the bearing plate keeps bearing grease out and lets packing be changed without lifting the shaft.
4. All product-contact welds inside the trough: GTAW with ER316L, back-purged where full penetration, ground flush and blended R3 min, #4 finish.
